exceptions.rationale: Maintainer-approved, narrowly scoped acceptance of the OpenAI SDK's current transitive tqdm dependency. This exception does not authorize other package versions, license expressions, or reciprocal licenses.
obligations: Preserve upstream copyright, license, and attribution notices.
Provide recipients with MPL-2.0 and MIT license texts or authoritative license URLs when redistributing the dependency.
If MPL-covered files are modified and distributed, make the corresponding MPL-covered source available under MPL-2.0 and satisfy its notice requirements.
Reassess the dependency and this exception no later than 2027-02-13; the exception expires automatically unless explicitly renewed.

PSF-2.0.rationale: SPDX-listed PSF 2.0 grants royalty-free redistribution and derivative works with retention of the PSF license and copyright notice; classify as NOTICE rather than UNKNOWN.
